mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_trade_agent_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM sys_trade_agent_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sys_trade_agent_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, session_id DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_trade_agent_session s JOIN sys_trade_agent_message m ON m.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND m.role = 'user' AND m.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND m.created_at < #{dayEnd}
AND (m.role = 'user' OR (m.role = 'assistant' AND m.tool_calls_json IS NULL)) ORDER BY m.message_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_trade_agent_message (session_id, role, content, tool_calls_json, tool_call_id, tool_name, structured_payload_json, tokens, created_at) SELECT session_id, #{message.role}, #{message.content}, #{message.toolCallsJson}, #{message.toolCallId}, #{message.toolName}, #{message.structuredPayloadJson}, #{message.tokens}, COALESCE(#{message.createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) FROM sys_trade_agent_session WHERE session_id = #{message.sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_trade_agent_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId}
